<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="a">
  <state id="a">
    <initial><transition type="internal" target="a1"/></initial>
    <history id="h"><transition type="internal" target="a1"/></history>
    <state id="a1"><transition event="go" target="b"/></state>
  </state>
  <state id="b">
    <initial><transition type="external" target="b1"/></initial>
    <history id="hb" type="deep"><transition type="external" target="b1"/></history>
    <state id="b1"><transition event="back" target="h"/><transition event="go" target="done"/></state>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>
